text.tspan: SLAB REINFORCING / FOUNDATION WORK BY OTHERS
RECOMMENDED SLAB THICKNESS BELOW DOOR BASE PLATES:
REQUIRED MINIMUM SLAB BELOW DOOR BASE PLATES:
* PLEASE COORDINATE LOCATION SLAB REINFORCING OUTSIDE OF BASE PLATE
FOOTPRINT TO PREVENT DAMAGE TO REBAR OR DELAYS TO INSTALLATION.
FINISHED TREATMENT LEVEL FLOOR SLAB CONDITION MUST BE FLAT / LEVEL WITH A TOLERANCE NOT TO
EXCEED 1/8" OVERALL WITHIN THE DOOR CAVITY.
MINIMUM CAVITY SIZE REQUIREMENTS VARY PER DOOR TYPE & MODEL.
ACCESS IS REQUIRED ON ONE SIDE FOR HAND CRANK & SERVICE
ACCESS IS REQUIRED ABOVE CEILING ALONG THE FRONT OF DOOR SUPPORT BEAM.
UTILIZE REMOVABLE CEILING TILES (ACT) OR PROVIDE ACCESS PANELS
